steps.description: Pre-filter the 12,000-gene matrix to genes with at least 10 counts in at least 1 sample (the smallest group size is 1) and report how many genes pass. Estimate median-of-ratios size factors with DESeq2 and extract normalized counts — do NOT pre-scale, CPM-transform or log the counts before size-factor estimation. Set the condition factor's reference level explicitly to the control level as named in metadata.csv, and define the contrast as (condition, treated, control) so a positive value means higher in treated. Compute a DESCRIPTIVE log2 fold change per gene as log2((normalized_treated + pseudocount) / (normalized_control + pseudocount)) with a stated pseudocount, and emit a single table with: gene symbol, raw counts per sample, normalized counts per sample, mean normalized count, and the descriptive log2FC, sorted by absolute log2FC. plan.title: Liver treated vs control: descriptive fold changes (n=1/group)
plan.analytical_narrative: The input is a 12,000 x 3 raw salmon gene-level count matrix (/data/inputs/counts/counts.csv, first column gene symbol) with a 2 x 2 sample table (/data/inputs/metadata/metadata.csv) describing one treated and one control human liver sample. The research question asks which genes are differentially expressed between the treated and the control sample. The design has NO biological replication — one sample per condition — so within-group dispersion cannot be estimated and no p-value from this design has an inferential basis. The knowledge service flags this explicitly (R-0003) and forbids an inferential DE test, and it drops the shrinkage and multiple-testing steps entirely. The plan therefore delivers what the data can actually support: (T1S1) sample-structure QC on the two libraries — library sizes, detected genes, blind VST, sample-to-sample distance and a treated-vs-control scatter/MA of the transformed values; (T1S2) median-of-ratios size factors, the 10-counts-in-at-least-1-sample pre-filter, and a table of normalized counts with DESCRIPTIVE log2 fold changes (treated / control, control as the explicit reference level) — ranked, with no p-value, no FDR, and no 'significant gene' call; (T2S1) a preranked fgsea run on the full gene list ranked by that descriptive log2 fold change against human MSigDB Hallmark and then Reactome, reported as an exploratory ordering of pathways with leading-edge genes and NO set-level p-value treated as evidence, because a rank built from an untested statistic cannot carry inference either; (T1S3) a report that states the no-replication limitation in the headline, names the design that would support inference (>=3 biological replicates per condition, or a paired design across subjects), and carries the reproducibility record. Every downstream claim is framed as a hypothesis for a replicated follow-up experiment, not a result.

Keep genes with at least 10 counts in at least 1 sample
Explicit reference level control, contrast treated vs control
Descriptive log fold changes only, no inferential test
